title: Cabot Corporation Prices $350 Million 4.950% Senior Notes Due 2029
summary: BOSTON­­, Aug. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) today announced that it priced a public offering of $350 million of 4.950% senior unsecured notes due 2029.
